item.title: ❗️ Today, during the daytime, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation delivered UAV strikes at
item.description: ❗️ Today, during the daytime, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation delivered UAV strikes at power infrastructure facilities, as well as vessels used in the interests of the AFU. 💥 As a result of the strike, the following targets were hit: three 110 kV power substations providing operation of defence industry facilities of Ukraine in Vinnitsa, in Obolonye (Chernigov region) and Rakitnoye (Rovno region). 🔥 In addition, a dry cargo ship delivering dual-use cargo to support the AFU was hit at sea in the Black Sea waters south-west of Odessa. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ✈️ Following strategic course Tu-160 aircraft crews performed a planned flight over the neutral waters of the Sea of Japan.
item.description: Following strategic course ✈️ Tu-160 aircraft crews performed a planned flight over the neutral waters of the Sea of Japan. ⏱️ The flight of the Russian Aerospace Forces' long-range aircraft lasted around 10 hours. It was escorted by Su-35s and Su-30sm fighter jets. ➡️ At certain stages of the route, the aircraft were escorted by foreign fighter jets. Crews of long-range aviation regularly conduct flights over the neutral waters of the Arctic, the North Atlantic, the Pacific Ocean, Black and Baltic seas. All Russian Aerospace Forces aircraft flights are carried out in strict compliance with international rules on the use of airspace. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🎖 by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 24 November 2026
item.description: 🎖 🎖 by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 24 November 2026 Part 2 ( 👉 see Part 1 ) 🚩 The Vostok Group's units continued to advance to the depths of the enemy's defence and liberated Barvinovka (Zaporozhye region). 🔥 They inflicted fire damage on manpower and hardware of two air assault brigades, one assault brigade, and one assault regiment of the AFU near Kolomiytsy, Gavrilovka, Zelenaya Dolina (Dnepropetrovsk region), Novotroitskoye, Zheltaya Krucha, Veseloye, and Schastlivoye (Zaporozhye region). ▪️ The AFU have lost more than 205 troops, one armoured personnel carrier, and three motor vehicles. 📍 The Dnepr Group's units improved the situation along the front line. Russian elements delivered strikes at formations of two mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine near Kirovo and Preobrazhenka (Zaporozhye region). ▪️ Up to 25 troops, 12 motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station have been neutralised. ✈️ Operational-tactical aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation have hit power and transport infrastructure facilities used in the interests of the AFU, military airfields, temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed forces and foreign mercenaries in 143 areas. ▫️ Air defence systems shot down 1,047 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles. 📊 In total, since the beginning of the special military operation, the enemy has lost: ▫️ 674 aircraft, ▫️ 284 helicopters, ▫️ 29
